brief: Trial NCT03068754 (Mallinckrodt). Why did it stop, what category is the stated reason, and were results posted on time?

findings.claim: Trial NCT03068754 was terminated with the stated why_stopped reason: "As recommended by the study's independent Data and Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB)"
The stated why_stopped category for trial NCT03068754 is safety.
findings.notes: Classified as safety based on the DSMB recommendation.

findings.claim: Results were posted on ClinicalTrials.gov on September 3, 2020, which was before the results due date of November 24, 2020 (days late: 0), meaning results were posted on time.
findings.notes: Results posted status is true with 0 days late.

findings.claim: Trial NCT03068754 start date was June 22, 2017, primary completion date was November 25, 2019, completion date was November 25, 2019, and enrollment was 143.
findings.notes: Dates and enrollment from trial record.

findings.claim: The drug Acthar has been approved by the FDA under multiple applications, including NDA008372 (Acthar Gel) and NDA022432 (H.P. Acthar Gel).

tool_calls.name: get_trial_live
tool_calls.result: NCT03068754: TERMINATED, why_stopped="As recommended by the study's independent Data and Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB"

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT03068754'
